Strings.proxy_server.intro: Manage the sing-box runtime on this server: inbound services, access credentials, client exports and subscriptions. Firewall rules, public DNS and certificate issuance stay outside this application.
Strings.proxy_server.install_hint: A configuration can only be published after the verified runtime is installed. Installation downloads a pinned sing-box build and verifies its SHA-256 digest.
Strings.proxy_server.uninstall_hint: Keeps configuration, credentials and generated keys so a later install can resume.
Strings.proxy_server.uninstall_warning: Uninstall the runtime? The service stops and inbound connections drop until it is installed again. Configuration and keys are kept.
Strings.proxy_server.uninstall_delete_warning: Uninstall the runtime and delete all Proxy Server data? Configuration, credentials, generated keys and subscriptions are removed and cannot be recovered.
Strings.proxy_server.restart_warning: Restart the service? Connected clients drop until the service is running again.
Strings.proxy_server.recovery_hint: The configuration the runtime loaded does not match the published revision. Recover the service, then publish again.
Strings.proxy_server.validation_hint: Validation renders the saved draft with the current keys and checks it with the sing-box binary. Nothing is published.
Strings.proxy_server.validation_ok: Configuration validation passed. Publish to apply it.
Strings.proxy_server.apply_warning: Publish the saved draft? A running service restarts and connected clients are interrupted. Confirm that credentials, ports and network access are correct.
Strings.proxy_server.rollback_warning: Restore the previously published configuration? The running service restarts and connected clients are interrupted.
Strings.proxy_server.publish_hint: Publishing swaps the rendered configuration, restarts a running service and interrupts connections. Only the applied revision can be exported or shared.
Strings.proxy_server.preview_hint: The preview is a redacted projection: secrets and REALITY private keys are replaced before display.
Strings.proxy_server.close_warning: Close Proxy Server? Unsaved edits will be lost. Submitted server operations continue; retain the operation ID to check their result.
Strings.proxy_server.rolled_back: Rolled back to the previous revision.
Strings.proxy_server.credential_saved: Credential saved. Publish to enforce the change.
Strings.proxy_server.operation_pending: Operation {0} accepted. Waiting for the server to finish.
Strings.proxy_server.session_changed: The login session or server changed. Reopen the application.
Strings.proxy_server.permission_denied: This account lacks the manage permission for Proxy Server.
Strings.proxy_server.request_failed: The server rejected the request. Check the connection and sign in again.
Strings.proxy_server.response_invalid: The server returned an unexpected response.
Strings.proxy_server.status_text: Service state, runtime version and the revision the runtime actually loaded.
Strings.proxy_server.name: Name
Strings.proxy_server.certificate_invalid: Enter a certificate id from the TLS certificate store.
Strings.proxy_server.inbound_hint: Each inbound listens on its own port. Public host, public port and SNI are what clients connect to; the listen address and port are what the runtime binds.
Strings.proxy_server.inbound_note: Changing a port or protocol of an inbound in use requires updating the credentials that reference it before publishing.
Strings.proxy_server.inbounds_empty: No inbound services yet. Create one to define where clients connect.
Strings.proxy_server.port_invalid: Enter a valid listen port between 1024 and 65535.
Strings.proxy_server.delete_inbound_warning: Delete this inbound from the draft? Credentials that reference it must be re-authorized before publishing.
Strings.proxy_server.principal_hint: A proxy user groups credentials by owner. Linking a RelaxKonOS account records who a credential belongs to; it never grants access by itself.
Strings.proxy_server.principal_required: Select or create a proxy user first.
Strings.proxy_server.principal_invalid: Enter a display name for the proxy user.
Strings.proxy_server.delete_principal_warning: Delete this proxy user? Credentials that still belong to it block the deletion.
Strings.proxy_server.credential_hint: A credential is a UUID for VLESS or a password for Trojan and Hysteria2. Saving a draft never revokes an existing connection; publishing does.
Strings.proxy_server.credentials_empty: No credentials yet. Create one and authorize at least one inbound.
Strings.proxy_server.grants_hint: A credential may span several inbounds only when they expect the same secret shape.
Strings.proxy_server.grants_required: Authorize at least one inbound for this credential.
Strings.proxy_server.expires: Expires at (ISO 8601, UTC; empty means no expiry)
Strings.proxy_server.expiry_invalid: Enter an expiry as ISO 8601 UTC, or leave the field empty.
Strings.proxy_server.rotate_warning: Rotate the secret now? The previous UUID or password stops working as soon as the change is published, and clients must be reconfigured.
Strings.proxy_server.rotation_note: Rotation never displays the new secret. Export it from the client connection page after publishing.
Strings.proxy_server.delete_credential_warning: Delete this credential? Its subscriptions are revoked and any client using it loses access as soon as the change is published.
Strings.proxy_server.export_hint: Pick a credential from an applied, running service. The export contains connection secrets; scan the URI with a client or import the matching configuration format.
Strings.proxy_server.export_requires_permission: Exporting a connection secret requires the export permission.
Strings.proxy_server.export_secret_note: Exports and subscription links bypass the management API and carry the connection secret. Share them only over a trusted channel.
Strings.proxy_server.formats_required: Select at least one export format.
Strings.proxy_server.subscription_base_url: Public base URL for subscription links
Strings.proxy_server.subscription_base_url_hint: Optional. Must be an HTTPS URL that reaches this server, for example https://proxy.example.com. Leave empty to return paths only.
Strings.proxy_server.subscription_hint: A subscription is a bearer link that carries the connection secret. The token is shown once and only its hash is stored.
Strings.proxy_server.subscription_issued: Subscription issued. Copy the token now; it is not shown again.
Strings.proxy_server.revoke_warning: Revoke this subscription? Any client using its link stops receiving the configuration immediately.
Strings.proxy_server.problem.action_invalid: The requested service action is not supported.
Strings.proxy_server.problem.certificate_invalid: The TLS certificate is missing or unreadable.
Strings.proxy_server.problem.configuration_drift: The runtime configuration differs from the published revision.
Strings.proxy_server.problem.configuration_not_a: The published configuration is not confirmed applied.
Strings.proxy_server.problem.credential_invalid: The credential secret does not match the inbound protocol.
Strings.proxy_server.problem.export_multiple_inb: A share URI carries one inbound. Use sing-box or Mihomo for a credential that spans several inbounds.
Strings.proxy_server.problem.export_partial: Only part of the requested export could be produced.
Strings.proxy_server.problem.export_unsupported: This export format is not supported for the selected credential.
Strings.proxy_server.problem.expiry_invalid: The expiry value is not a valid timestamp.
Strings.proxy_server.problem.feature_unsupported: This capability is not available on this build.
Strings.proxy_server.problem.formats_required: Select at least one export format.
Strings.proxy_server.problem.grants_required: A credential must authorize at least one inbound.
Strings.proxy_server.problem.handshake_address_f: The REALITY handshake host must be a public address.
Strings.proxy_server.problem.helper_invalid_resp: The privileged helper returned an unexpected response.
Strings.proxy_server.problem.helper_unavailable: The privileged helper is not available.
Strings.proxy_server.problem.idempotency_conflic: This idempotency key was already used for a different request.
Strings.proxy_server.problem.idempotency_key_req: The request is missing an idempotency key.
Strings.proxy_server.problem.keys_invalid: The stored REALITY key material is invalid.
Strings.proxy_server.problem.keys_missing: The REALITY key material for an inbound is missing.
Strings.proxy_server.problem.network_conflict: Another inbound already uses this address and port.
Strings.proxy_server.problem.operation_limit: Too many operations are queued. Retry shortly.
Strings.proxy_server.problem.operation_unavailab: The operation is unknown or has expired.
Strings.proxy_server.problem.permission_denied: This account lacks the required permission.
Strings.proxy_server.problem.platform_unsupporte: Proxy Server is not supported on this platform.
Strings.proxy_server.problem.port_invalid: The port is outside the allowed range.
Strings.proxy_server.problem.principal_has_crede: Credentials still belong to this proxy user.
Strings.proxy_server.problem.principal_not_found: The proxy user no longer exists.
Strings.proxy_server.problem.publication_unconfi: The runtime did not confirm the published configuration.
Strings.proxy_server.problem.recovery_required: The runtime needs recovery before it can be published again.
Strings.proxy_server.problem.release_unsupported: This release is not available for the host platform.
Strings.proxy_server.problem.response_invalid: The response could not be read.
Strings.proxy_server.problem.revision_conflict: The draft changed on the server. Refresh and try again.
Strings.proxy_server.problem.rollback_unavailabl: No previous revision is available to roll back to.
Strings.proxy_server.problem.runtime_failed: The sing-box runtime reported a failure.
Strings.proxy_server.problem.runtime_unavailable: The runtime is not installed or not running.
Strings.proxy_server.problem.state_invalid: The request does not fit the current state.
Strings.proxy_server.problem.statistics_unavaila: Traffic statistics are not available on this build.
Strings.proxy_server.problem.subscription_base_i: The subscription base URL must be an absolute HTTPS URL.
Strings.proxy_server.problem.subscription_limit: This credential has reached the subscription limit.
Strings.proxy_server.problem.subscription_not_fo: The subscription does not exist or has expired.
Strings.proxy_server.problem.uninstall_failed: The runtime could not be uninstalled.
Strings.application.relaxkonos.proxy-server.desc: Manage the sing-box runtime on this server: inbound services, access credentials, client exports and subscriptions.
